# SuperWeb

SuperWeb is a WebMCP application for the fictional Kestrel Supply Co. The page
registers tools through `document.modelContext`. Those tools use the same store
state and API endpoints as the visible React interface.

Live application: https://webmcp-superweb.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb

## How to use the site

Open the live page in ChatGPT's in-app browser or Chrome with WebMCP enabled.
The application is client-rendered, so an HTTP fetch of the root returns only
the shell. Use the page's registered tools instead of crawling for sub-pages.

The public catalogue is visible when no staff session is selected. Staff sign
in is a human control and has no tool. Selecting a staff identity replaces the
catalogue with the dashboard and changes the registered tool set.

## Public catalogue

The catalogue contains 28 photographed products. Its tools can:

- search, filter, page, open, and compare product families
- manage the current cart and wishlist
- send an enquiry from the selected customer session
- list promotions and check the metric slice behind each claim
- switch the interface among English, Spanish, French, German, and Japanese

`search_catalog_form` comes from the search form's HTML. The other tools are
registered from TypeScript.

Opening a product with a Kestrel-authored profile adds
`get_preview_recipe`. The profile contains written guidance and may offer named
photo treatments. It is not a manufacturer specification. The catalogue has no
sensor size, aperture, wattage, or decibel fields, and the tool supplies none.

## Internal dashboard

The dashboard reads six metrics from committed DuckDB parquet files. Its tools
can read a figure, split it by a supported dimension, describe its definition,
check an exact slice, draft a report, and trace missing rows through the
pipeline.

The demo period is November 2023. A deliberate EUR to USD rate gap rejects
7,831 of 31,084 order lines. Germany loses all 1,739 lines and must not receive a
report figure. Online loses 4,788 of 18,831 lines and keeps its figure only with
the 25.4 percent gap attached.

Trust has four outcomes:

- `ok` can be published as written
- `degraded` keeps the figure with its warning
- `blocked` publishes no figure
- `unchecked` means no check exists for the exact slice

`draft_report` reads figures from `/api/query`; it accepts no numeric input.
The draft appears on the page and waits for a person to press **Approve for
export**. No registered tool can approve it. `build_deck` returns a slide
outline only after that click.

## Boundaries

The staff switcher is a demo session, not authentication. Its audience value
changes answer depth. It does not decide who may ask a question.

WebMCP results are text in the Chrome build tested by this repository. Product
photos do not cross the tool call. A preview recipe may be handed to a separate
image model with a user-owned photo, but it remains an illustrative treatment.
